dedupe_keys.name: pima adapta impactos escenarios de inundacion

description: PIMA Adapta. Impactos - Escenarios de Inundación is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by terramapas.icv.gva.es. Various flood scenarios: Scenario 1: Maximum flood event T=100 years in the current climate Scenario 2: Maximum flood event T=500 years in the current climate Scenario 3: Maximum flood event T= 100 years + increase in MSL corresponding to RCP4.5. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "PIMA Adapta. Impacts - Flood Scenarios" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include riesgo de inundación, Cambio climático, ICV_CLAS:Medi ambient;Canvi climàtic, IDEV, Impact, Comunitat Valenciana. The listing shows 1 download or service links in TIFF. The listing shows 2021-04-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
